title: N.C.R.B. (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1997 2.6.3 It is seen that 95.1 per cent of all cases registered in the cities were categorised under `Other SLL Crimes', comparatively this per cent at national level was lower at 78.6 per cent, signifying higher registration of cases under Local Laws of the State than under Special Laws under study.
